The Steyr Scout is a bolt-action rifle manufactured by Steyr Mannlicher, intended to fill the role of a versatile, lightweight all-around rifle. Apart from the barrel and action, the gun is made primarily of polymers and is designed to be accurate to at least 800 m (870 yd).
 This is the 5.56 model.
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]ATTACHMENTS: 
 %c[d_purple] - %c[ui_gray_2] Surefire SOCOM556-MONSTER suppressor

The Steyr Scout is a bolt-action rifle manufactured by Steyr Mannlicher, intended to fill the role of a versatile, lightweight all-around rifle. Apart from the barrel and action, the gun is made primarily of polymers and is designed to be accurate to at least 800 m (870 yd).
 The Steyr Elite is a sniper rifle variant and successor of the Scout, with a more robust construction and designed for an urban tactical role. This is the 7.62 model.
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]ATTACHMENTS: 
 %c[d_purple] - %c[ui_gray_2] Daniel Defence Wave QD suppressor
Standard magazine for the Steyr Scout 5.56 rifle, with capacity for 10 rounds.\n \n
Standard magazine for the Steyr Elite 7.62 rifle, with capacity for 5 rounds.\n \n
